description: Public BillBot market datasets for scheduled AI monitoring; no Lovable/Supabase or user-specific information.
license_note: NBN plan data originates with NBN Tracker (CC BY-SA 4.0). Energy and savings data includes public CDR source records; check providers for current terms.
refresh: Automatic after successfully validated market updater runs; ALWAYS fetch latest manifest before each automated review.

instructions: Read latest manifest.json, then the electricity index. Do not download and parse HTML tabs.
Given a four-digit postcode P and known distributor D, form the union of index.global, index.postcodes[P] and the IDs in index.distributors whose name matches D.
Fetch only the index.chunks entries at those chunk indexes, prefixing relative paths with https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oswade/bbdata/main/public-data/.

Filter rows for residential customer_type, nonstale records, and geographical eligibility. Inspect geo.included_postcodes, geo.excluded_postcodes, geo.included_distributors, geo.excluded_distributors to exclude ineligible offers.

Full tariff contract is in detail.c, including tariffPeriod, fees and eligibility. daily_supply_cents/avg_usage_cents alone are not an accurate annual cost. Match controlled-load and time-of-use terms to the user's bill.
electricity.pricing_warning: Must account for contract periods/blocks, peak/off-peak, usage, controlled loads, conditional discounts and fees. If uncertain do not calculate an exact annual price.

gas.instructions: Use same index/chunk method as electricity. Gas annual usage is MJ, not kWh. Check postcode, network and tariff blocks.

nbn.instructions: Filter desired NBN speed tier. Compare standard monthly recurring price separately from any discounted promotional period; include CIS URLs.

savings.instructions: Distinguish base/ongoing interest from time-limited introductory promotional rates and check balance tiers, deposits, transaction requirements and fees.

privacy: All URLs are public market files. Personal bills, identity, and usage data entered in the browser are NOT available publicly and cannot be fetched by unattended tasks. A user may deliberately paste household usage into their task or attach the browser's local JSON export to a chat.
fail_safe: If data are unavailable, obsolete, unverified or insufficient to calculate tariffs, explicitly report limitations. Never hallucinate offers or exact savings.
